interface.longDescription: Content caster (铸). Transforms content into PNG visuals. Six molds: -l (default) long reading card, -i infograph, -m multi-card reading cards (1080x1440), -v visual sketchnote, -c comic (manga-style B&W), -w whiteboard (marker-style board layout). Output to ~/Downloads/. Use when user says '铸', 'cast', '做成图', '做成卡片', '做成信息图', '做成海报', '视觉笔记', 'sketchnote', '漫画', 'comic', 'manga', '白板', 'whiteboard'. Replaces cjl-cards and cjl-infograph.
